en.title: It Doesn't Bark, It Whistles! Can You Name This Animal?
en.description: The dhole, an Asian wild dog, whistles instead of barking or howling. It hunts in packs of about 12 that bring down large deer such as sambar, and fewer than 2,500 adults remain in the wild.
